user.title: Shelly Gate
user.description: Build a cover out of a gate operator that has a single momentary input and no position feedback. Every trigger advances the operator through open → stop → close → stop, and the position is worked out from the travel times you set afterwards.

data_description.name: Name of the cover entity, for example Garage Tuin.
data_description.trigger_entity: The output wired to the operator's push-button input. A switch is pulsed on and off again; a button or script is simply fired.
data_description.button_entity: Optional. The input that reports a press on the physical wall button, so the cover follows presses it did not make itself.
data_description.device_class: Decides the icon and the wording used for the cover.

reconfigure.title: Shelly Gate
reconfigure.description: Change the name or the entities this gate is built from.

data_description.name: Name of the cover entity.
data_description.trigger_entity: The output wired to the operator's push-button input.
data_description.button_entity: Optional. The input that reports a press on the physical wall button.
data_description.device_class: Decides the icon and the wording used for the cover.

error.same_entity: The wall button cannot be the same entity as the trigger.

abort.already_configured: That trigger is already used by another gate.

init.title: Shelly Gate timings
init.description: Time the gate with a stopwatch and enter what you measured. The position is dead-reckoned from these values, so they are what makes it accurate.

data_description.travel_up_seconds: How long the gate takes to travel from fully closed to fully open.
data_description.travel_down_seconds: How long the gate takes to travel from fully open to fully closed.
data_description.pulse_seconds: How long the trigger is held on to register as one press. Ignored for a button or script trigger.
data_description.pulse_gap_seconds: How long to wait between presses when several are needed to get the operator moving the right way. Too short and the operator ignores them.
